function dy = prob_mod_dynamics_LV(t, y, p) %#ok<INUSD>
%PROB_MOD_DYNAMICS_LV Generated CUQDyn dynamics function.
% Generated by cuqdyn_generate_problem_files.
%
% States:
%   y(1) = Prey
%   y(2) = Predator
% Parameters:
%   p(1) = alpha
%   p(2) = beta
%   p(3) = delta
%   p(4) = gamma

dy = zeros(2, 1, 'like', y);

Prey = y(1);
Predator = y(2);

alpha = p(1);
beta = p(2);
delta = p(3);
gamma = p(4);

dy(1) = (alpha - beta*Predator)*Prey;
dy(2) = (delta*Prey - gamma)*Predator;
end
